name: Sex Before Marriage
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that sexual intimacy is designed by God to be experienced within the covenant of marriage, as seen in Genesis 2:24 where a man and wife become one flesh. The narrative of Joseph in Genesis 39:7 illustrates the importance of resisting sexual temptation outside of marriage. Exodus 22:16 emphasizes the responsibility and seriousness of engaging in sexual relations before betrothal, requiring the man to marry the woman. Hebrews 13:4 upholds the sanctity of marriage and the purity of the marriage bed, warning that God will judge those who engage in sexual immorality outside this sacred union.
